auth.signInSubtitle: Use your staff account to continue.
auth.sessionExpired: Your session ended. Please sign in again.

dashboard.intro: This is your admin home. Sections you have access to are in the menu.

comingSoon.title: {{section}}
comingSoon.body: This section is being built and will appear in a later release.

noAccess.title: No sections yet
noAccess.body: Your account has no permissions assigned. Ask an administrator to give you a role.

forbidden.title: Access denied
forbidden.body: You don't have permission to view this page.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The page you are looking for does not exist.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: Can't reach the server. Check your connection.
errors.ACCOUNT_LOCKED: Too many failed attempts. Your account is temporarily locked — try again later.
errors.ACCOUNT_DISABLED: Your account is disabled. Contact an administrator.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Please wait a moment and try again.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You don't have permission to do that.
errors.TOKEN_INVALID: Your session ended. Please sign in again.
errors.TOKEN_EXPIRED: Your session ended. Please sign in again.
errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE: This file isn't a supported image (JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF or AVIF).
errors.SLUG_TAKEN: This URL slug is already used. Choose another.
errors.INVALID_MOVE: A category can't be moved inside itself or one of its subcategories.
errors.CATEGORY_HAS_CHILDREN: Move or delete its subcategories first.
errors.CATEGORY_IN_USE: Products still use this category. Move them first.
errors.SUPPLIER_IN_USE: Products or purchase orders still use this supplier.
errors.SKU_TAKEN: This SKU is already used by another product.
errors.BARCODE_TAKEN: This barcode is already used by another product.

name.invalid: Use letters, spaces, apostrophes, dots or hyphens only.

money.zero: Amount must be greater than zero.

quantity.invalid: Enter a whole number of 1 or more.

code.invalid: Use A–Z, 0–9, dash, underscore or dot only.

slug.invalid: Use lowercase letters, numbers and single hyphens.

validation.placeholdersChanged: Keep every placeholder like {{name}} exactly as in the English text.

product.singleVariant: A product without options has exactly one variant.
product.variantOptions: Choose one value for every option.
product.compareAtPrice: The compare-at price must be higher than the price.
product.variantImage: Variant images must be in the product gallery.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Store-wide configuration. Changes are saved immediately and recorded in the audit log.
settings.readOnly: You can view these settings but not change them.

provider.title: Automatic translation
provider.description: English is the only language you write in. Arabic is generated automatically by this engine and can be corrected below.
provider.apiKeySet: A key is saved ({{masked}}). Type a new one to replace it.
provider.apiKeyHelp: Only needed if your LibreTranslate server requires keys.
provider.testFailed: The engine did not return a usable translation. Check the address and that the server is running.
provider.testOff: Automatic translation is off. Choose an engine and save first.

storefront.title: Storefront language
storefront.description: How the Arabic version of your website behaves for visitors.
storefront.autoDetectHelp: First-time visitors whose browser prefers Arabic open the Arabic site. Search engines are never redirected.
storefront.digitsHelp: Most Saudi stores use Western digits.

glossary.title: Glossary
glossary.description: Teach the engine your vocabulary once: words to keep as-is (brands, payment methods) and your preferred translation for common shop terms. Changes apply to new translations; use “Retranslate everything” to update existing ones.

ui.title: Storefront text
ui.description: Website labels translated by the engine. Correct any that are wrong — your version goes live within a minute and is never overwritten. Keep placeholders like {{store}} exactly as they are.

queue.title: Translation status
queue.description: Background translation of products, pages and other content.
queue.providerOff: Automatic translation is off, so new content stays in English until you enable an engine and retry.
queue.unavailable: The job queue is unreachable right now (Redis). Translation will resume automatically.
queue.uiNote: Website labels are generated by developers with “npm run i18n:translate”; correct them in “Storefront text” above.

media.title: Media library
media.description: Images for products, categories and pages. Uploads are checked, resized, converted to WebP and stripped of hidden data such as location.
media.search: Search by name or alt text
media.empty: No images yet. Upload some above.

upload.title: Upload images
upload.hint: JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF or AVIF. Large images are scaled down automatically.

details.name: Name
details.altHint: Describe the image for search engines and screen readers. Arabic is generated automatically.
details.confirmDelete: Remove from the library? Pages and products already using it keep working.

picker.title: Choose an image
picker.description: Pick from the media library or upload a new image.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Organize the catalog. The order here is the order on the storefront. Arabic is generated automatically.
categories.selectHint: Select a category to edit it, or add a new one.
categories.reorderHint: Drag the handle to reorder. To move a category under another one, change its parent.

dnd.instructions: To reorder, press Space, use the arrow keys to move, and press Space again to drop. Press Escape to cancel.

form.name: Name
form.slugAuto: Leave empty to create it from the name.
form.slugHint: Changing it changes the page address.
form.activeHint: Hiding a category also hides its subcategories.

brands.title: Brands
brands.description: Brand names are never translated. Descriptions and SEO text get Arabic automatically.

form.name: Brand name
form.protectNameHint: Keeps the brand name as-is in Arabic product text. Turn off for brands that are common words (e.g. "Apple" would also stop "apple juice" from being translated).

suppliers.title: Suppliers
suppliers.description: Companies you buy stock from. Used by products and purchase orders. Internal only.
suppliers.search: Search by name, contact, email, phone or tax number

form.name: Company name
form.phoneHint: Saudi mobiles like 05XXXXXXXX, or any number in +country format.

products.title: Products
products.description: Everything you sell online and in store. Write in English — Arabic is generated automatically.
products.search: Search by name, SKU or barcode
products.readOnly: You can view this product but not change it.
products.confirmDelete: Delete this product? It disappears from the shop; past orders keep their copy.

form.name: Product name
form.statusHint: Only active products are shown on the storefront.

gallery.description: The first image is the main image. Drag to reorder.
gallery.hint: Drag the handle to change the order.

options.description: Options like Color or Size. Every combination becomes a variant with its own SKU and price.
options.none: No options — this product is sold as a single item.
options.name: Option name
options.addValuePlaceholder: Type a value and press Enter

variants.description: Turn off combinations you don’t sell. Prices include VAT when the store shows VAT-inclusive prices.
variants.imagesHint: Pick the gallery images that show this variant. The first picked is its main image.
variants.skuPrefixHint: New variants get SKUs like PREFIX-RED-M. Defaults to the product name.

unsaved.title: Leave without saving?
unsaved.body: Your changes to this product will be lost.

customFields.description: Extra fields shown on every product form. Labels get Arabic automatically; values you type are never translated — use a dropdown for values that should appear in Arabic.

form.label: Label
form.keyHint: Used in imports/exports. Leave empty to create it from the label.
form.activeHint: Inactive fields are hidden but keep their saved values.
